What to record: Identify room, cabinet, assembly ID, and released revision.
Record the person responsible and assembly date or shift.
List the parts and material group entering the operation.
State the face, edge, datum, drawing note, or tolerance used.
Example: Front edges flush / diagonals within 1 mm

What to record: Record actual thickness, jig scale, drill stop, and bit condition.
Record screw type, length, quantity, spacing, and permitted face.
Record pull-up, breakthrough, split, alignment, and torque method.
Record assembly IDs, rejected holes, repairs, and final inspection.
Example: Frames F1-F6 / one plugged and redrilled
